## dependency_form

Hop marks from the blind answer: all three hops state-derived, none pre-solved. Scan of the whole corpus:
- Each prerequisite sentence appears verbatim once, in the blocked policy's hub; the same-form summary "Both are states of the current block's hours ledger: the quoted price is the one figured once the ledger shows them" restates them in the same document without naming any action, performer or tool.
- Each task tool name occurs only in its own hub (grep over docs/*: sign_repeat_block_order_5562f94d -> repeat_block_order_signing only; post_visit_travel_entry_8d0122c7 -> onsite_travel_entry_posting only; post_service_visit_draw_abd20ee9 -> onsite_service_visit_draws only). No policy id, factor id or "see/set out elsewhere" pointer in any title/content.
- No dependency table, checklist, route or ordered cross-problem step list; no wrong-vs-right contrast; no example walking across problems.
- Titles are general subjects ("Repeat Orders of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Block and the Repeat-Order Form" names the on_request policy's own request type).
- Computation documents carry no modifier hint; the repeat-order "Reduction" sentence ("The percentages that apply to the order are added into one total") is the source's assembly stated generically, naming no factor. Factor documents name no other document or factor and state no customer's tier. The travel tool's `time_band` row ("after_hours ... which is also how a weekend or holiday trip is drawn and recorded") is the task_tools.py docstring carried verbatim.

**KB-EXPLICIT: PASS.**

## cross-product seed rows (task 0 world; exhaustive pass)

Checked against the published docs of the owning product:
- managed_tickets (all 11 tickets, 33 milestones): billable minutes are multiples of the Standard 15-minute increment with remote 15 / onsite 60 minimums (L4); labor classes agree with Standard coverage Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00 (SB-2249362 resolved 20:55 and SB-2306631 resolved 20:30 after-hours; the rest within coverage); onboarding tickets covered and included (scope guide + L3); timebank route only with an active block whose balance covers the minutes (L6). Consistent, except item SEED-SCOPE-HOWTO below.
- managed_agreements: tier/status/go-live/seat_count 34 = 30 + 2 + 1 + 1 seat adds (each add dated its onboarding ticket's resolution); contracted 34 = covered seats at the 2026-07-14 term end (Schedule renewal 3.3). Consistent.
- managed_billing: **SEED-MGB-0** — the monthly fee rows for service months 2026-05, 2026-06 and 2026-07 (INV-581190/581191/581192, posted 05-01, 06-01, 07-01) are 4194.92 = 34 x 123.38, the per-seat rate of the term that started 2026-07-15. Under the published renewal documents (renewal_term_rate, renewal_price_protection, first-renewal and long-tenure uplift: automatic renewal, 8th renewal, live >= 60 months -> lowest of expiring x 1.04, list 124.00 and expiring x 1.02) the renewed rate is strictly above the expiring rate, and a service month's fee is fixed under the term covering its first day ("Term in force"), so those three months cannot carry 123.38 (123.38 = 120.96 x 1.02 implies an expiring rate of 120.96, i.e. 4112.64 per month). Payments (ACH, day 17-20, net 30) and the open October fee are consistent. No TimeBank figure reads these rows; no scored value moves.
- TimeBank history rows (8 draws, 2 travel entries, grant, invoice, payment, order): each reproduces under the current published TimeBank rules (e.g. SB-2249362 after-hours phone P3: 75 min x 1.5 x 0.95 = 1.78; both 0.54 trips = 85.00 / 158.00 with business band and lead >= 2 days). Consistent.
- **SEED-SCOPE-HOWTO (plausible)** — SB-2275518 (how_to, email, remote business hours, 45 min) is recorded `billable_out_of_scope` and drawn from the block (0.75 h). ClearPath Standard includes "Covered remote help desk work during coverage hours" (tier entitlements matrix) and the scope guide covers "help desk work" on such a tier, under which a how-to question would be covered and its remote labor included (L3), not routed to TimeBank. The managed docs define no category-to-scope mapping, so this rests on reading a how-to question as help desk work. No scored value moves (usage share without it 0.712, same 2 percent tier).
- No hardware, project, security, backup or licensing records exist for this client.
